stories.h: Shield AI to buy Kirkland radar maker for $5.3 billion
stories.s: Shield AI agreed to acquire Kirkland-based radar maker Echodyne for up to $5.3 billion.
CEO Kelly Kinnison stepped down after an audit found $16.7 million could not be recovered.

stories.h: Seattle bars ICE from city property
stories.s: Mayor Wilson barred federal agents from using city property, including parks and Seattle Center.
Heavy rain is expected across the Puget Sound region Tuesday through Thursday.

coming.s: Most city and county offices close Wednesday for Veterans Day.
